TaxonomyManager.infoDescription: Labels Airi uses to classify conversations for requests, analytics, scenarios, and reports.
TaxonomyManager.usedInList: Classification, quick replies, insights, campaign segments, reports
TaxonomyManager.logicDescription: The classifier stores one label per conversation:
TaxonomyManager.logicStep1: Airi analyzes the conversation and picks one label from this taxonomy.
TaxonomyManager.logicStep2: If the AI's confidence is below your Confidence Threshold, the category is set to "Other" instead.
TaxonomyManager.logicStep3: If the AI returns a label that does not exactly match a taxonomy label, it falls back to "Other".
TaxonomyManager.logicStep4: The assigned category is stored as classification.category and used for filtering, analytics, scenarios, and campaigns.
TaxonomyManager.logicNote: Each conversation stores which taxonomy version was used (taxonomy_id) for audit and consistency.
TaxonomyManager.labelsDescription: One topic per conversation. Other is the fallback.
TaxonomyManager.guidelinesDescription: Tell the classifier when each label should be used.
TaxonomyManager.guidelinesPlaceholder: e.g., Use discrete, mutually exclusive categories. Prefer specific business intents over generic when obvious. Default to Other if unclear.
TaxonomyManager.fewShotDescription: Show which topic fits a customer message.
TaxonomyManager.exampleTextPlaceholder: e.g., How much is the pro plan? Do you have annual billing?
TaxonomyManager.confidenceDescription: From 0 to 1. Higher values send more conversations to Other.
